causal_policy.rk_stages: all four stages use the same current native frame i

checkpoint.ordering: atomic checkpoint state is written before each HDF5 frame append
checkpoint.resume_source_of_truth: checkpoint state; HDF5 is truncated to checkpoint frame before rewrite

error_budget.analytic_upper_bound: 0.5*Hessian_bound*weighted_second_moment*condition_amplification when an independent H bound is supplied
error_budget.reconstruction_residual: weighted affine MLS fit residual is an estimate only

event_definition.contact: continuous downward crossing from z>plane to z<=plane on a usable RK4 segment
event_definition.residence: linear RK segment time inside destination box after contact; right-censored if no return
event_definition.return: continuous downward crossing after upward event from z>plane to z<=plane
event_definition.unusable_segment: no event update; query becomes permanent_unknown
event_definition.upward: continuous upward crossing after contact from z<=plane to z>plane

binding.integration: classical explicit RK4 with fixed current-frame field over each native interval
binding.query_identity: independent geometric seed; native particle_id and initial Mk are not used
binding.query_mass: equal positive mass; all seeds remain in denominator, including permanent_unknown

temporal_accuracy.current_frame_field_hold: piecewise-constant native field over each saved interval; cross-frame field time accuracy is first-order hold
temporal_accuracy.rk4_scope: RK4 improves spatial integration of the frozen current-frame velocity field only; it does not make the overall native-frame temporal interpolation fourth-order

binding.unknown_policy: any failed support stage becomes permanent_unknown and is excluded from later event updates

material_reliability_status: not_assessed; numerical support reliability is not a material truth claim
